title: Term Life Insurance Long-Standing Fee Concession: Installment After the Accidental Death Rider Ends
content:
**Concession terms.** In the installment after the accidental death rider ends on a Term Life Insurance policy, a long-standing fee concession is taken off the fee before sharing according to the policy years completed — the whole years from the issue date to today:

| Policy years completed | Concession |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 10.00 |
| 10 through 19 | 5.00 |
| fewer than 10 | nothing |

The policy fee never falls below nothing after the concession.

**Q&A.**

*A policy issued 15 November 2005 is reckoned on 14 November 2025. What concession applies?* 19 whole years are completed: 5.00.

*And on 15 November 2025?* 20 whole years: 10.00.

*A fee before sharing of 50.00 with 20 completed years?* 50.00 less 10.00, which is 40.00 before the fee share.
